annotations.text:
BUILD SOMETHING! — v1 screen set
Direction: dark phosphor mission-control in Penn State colors — Nittany-navy ground, Pugh-blue #96BEE6 phosphor, amber #FFB03A alerts. Chakra Petch + IBM Plex Mono.
Top row is the funnel: land → intake → spin → kickoff prompt. Bottom row: quest log, build board, get set up.
All stats, student names, and projects are sample data — one persona (Sheetz + intramural volleyball) runs through the whole funnel so the screens tell a single story.
